workload: Real production host and Kubernetes UI, 5,000 source-view records; in-page fixture backend, not a live cluster. Normal React production build without React profiling overhead. This describes nominalScroll; viewportJump is an unknown legacy workload (see provenance.workloads).

provenance.retained: No host or Kubernetes UI working-tree diff, build input, built frontend bundle, built Kubernetes bundle or bundle hash from any measured run was retained.
provenance.sourceBaseCommits: Pinned workspace bases from the CLI manifest. They are not proof of the measured sources: both viewportJump metas record dirty=true for the host, and no run recorded the Kubernetes plugin's dirty state.

frontendBuild.receipt: The workload field records a normal React production build without React profiling overhead. Every viewportJump run reports zero React profiler commits and render time.
frontendBuild.bench/app: bench/app/run.mjs builds bench/app/vite.config.ts: react-dom/profiling with a <Profiler>, so its React columns and timings include profiling overhead.
frontendBuild.note: The configuration, flags and artifacts that produced these historical results were not retained.

workloads.nominalScroll: Described by the top-level workload field; tail.lastIndex is 4999. No workload id was recorded.
workloads.viewportJump: Unknown legacy workload. The runner recorded no workload id or record count, so these results are not relabeled as the 5,000-record collection.

nominalScroll.method: 180 requestAnimationFrame steps, 60px per step, 1440x900 viewport. DOM range coverage sampling adds measurement overhead. Not compositor-paint or M1 certification.

limits: Full-viewport jump rendering regressed versus baseline. Nominal fourfold-throttled frame timing improved, but does not meet 60fps. No buttery-smooth success claim.
The baseline fixture did not reproduce black rows. Zero sampled missing ranges in both baseline and candidate is not proof of native compositor behavior.

CLI browser workspace launch stalled at starting-host and timed out after 1200 seconds. Static retry failed owned-cache validation. Recover after down failed on generated kubernetes/ui/node_modules/.tmp. Issues recorded. No live cluster end-to-end measurement.

The older baseline runner recorded the host commit as k8sPlugin. That raw value is retained as k8sPluginRaw and is invalid; the baseline plugin source is unknown.
